meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release.
meta.coverage: All India, rural/urban/combined; proprietary & partnership establishments — per-1000 distribution of owners/major partners by social group (indicator 6, activity All, all establishment types) and by general education (indicator 5)
meta.note: Per-1000 distributions as published (integers; components can miss 1000 by a few parts from rounding). Both tables describe the owner or major partner of proprietary and partnership establishments only — corporate forms have no single owner to classify. The published "All" rows (=1000) are not baked; group shares are served rows, nothing is computed here.
